prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity, shippable desktop ABOUT PAGE website surface, 1536×1024 landscape
Primary request: Create “The Decision Register,” a distinct About page for Marc Mansour’s public portfolio. This must unmistakably be an About page, not a homepage and not a poster. Preserve the exact visual world, component character, top navigation chrome, and closing footer chrome of the supplied homepage pixel reference, while replacing all homepage-specific content with the About-page structure below.
Input images: Image 1 is the pixel-authoritative style and system reference. Preserve its light recycled ruled paper, cobalt hairline geometry, typography roles, square controls, sparse lime data accents, rare signal-red proof gesture, workbook navigation, and dark footer-index character. Do not reuse its hero, GitHub activity, financial app dossier, projects, or homepage section copy.
Scene/backdrop: A straight-on 1536×1024 screenshot of a real desktop website at the top of the About route, with no browser chrome, no device frame, and no perspective. Cool off-white recycled paper with faint fibers and subtle 32px horizontal rules. A single pale red notebook margin line and continuous cobalt blue page divisions. Show the full first viewport and enough continuation toward the bottom to establish the closing action and footer system.
Subject: The About page is a decision register that explains the true path from investment-banking context to software development and public writing. The short editorial lead states exactly: “I work in investment banking. The technical challenges I meet there pushed me toward software development.” Follow it with four large, numbered ledger entries 01–04. Every entry must have three clearly indexed columns labeled “MOMENT”, “TENSION”, and “PRESENT RELEVANCE”.
Exact page structure and text:
Top chrome: “Marc Mansour”; “HOME”; “PROJECTS”; “ABOUT”; “RESUME”; “CONTACT”; “BLOG”; make “ABOUT” the active tab with the same signal-red underline treatment as the reference. Preserve the small workbook page-register character at the far right without adding a date or metric.
Page title: “About”
Editorial lead: “I work in investment banking. The technical challenges I meet there pushed me toward software development.”
Register title: “THE DECISION REGISTER”
Entry 01 title: “FINANCE CONTEXT”
01 MOMENT: “Investment banking is where the questions begin.”
01 TENSION: “Financial work exposes technical challenges.”
01 PRESENT RELEVANCE: “Those challenges shape what I choose to build.”
Entry 02 title: “RECURRING TECHNICAL FRICTION”
02 MOMENT: “A technical obstacle repeats.”
02 TENSION: “The work needs a clearer, more inspectable path.”
02 PRESENT RELEVANCE: “I treat friction as a software question.”
Entry 03 title: “BUILDING WITH CODE”
03 MOMENT: “Software development became the method.”
03 TENSION: “Complex systems must stay legible.”
03 PRESENT RELEVANCE: “I build financial tools that make their logic easier to inspect.”
Entry 04 title: “PUBLISHING THE WORK”
04 MOMENT: “The work leaves the private notebook.”
04 TENSION: “Technical and financial readers arrive with different contexts.”
04 PRESENT RELEVANCE: “I write about technology, development, and finance for a broad public.”
Closing actions: primary “START A CONVERSATION”; secondary “OPEN RÉSUMÉ”.
Style/medium: Production-realistic editorial portfolio UI matching the supplied reference at high fidelity. Bitter-like sturdy editorial display serif for “About,” the lead, entry numbers, and major entry titles; Open Sans-like highly readable body text; Source Code Pro-like compact uppercase labels, navigation, table indices, and actions. The page should feel like a disciplined analyst’s working paper and inspectable decision log, tactile but mostly flat.
Composition/framing: Preserve the reference’s narrow workbook header at the top, asymmetric left alignment, cobalt outer frame, and page gutter. Immediately below the header, create an editorial lead zone with a monumental left-anchored “About” and the core-truth paragraph placed as a strong reading block, not a centered hero. Beneath it, create one continuous ruled register rather than separate cards. Entries 01–04 are large horizontal ledger bands with oversized serif numerals at the left, the entry title next, and MOMENT / TENSION / PRESENT RELEVANCE aligned across explicit columns. Make each entry visibly distinct through alternating ruled-paper density, divider geometry, and sparse proof notation, never rounded containers. Reveal all four entries clearly in the 1024px frame; the fourth can lead into a closing cobalt-ruled action band. End with “START A CONVERSATION” as a square cobalt button and “OPEN RÉSUMÉ” as a square outlined secondary control. At the bottom edge, show a slim dark-ink footer index using the same square, ruled component language; do not invent contact addresses or social handles.
Color palette: recycled paper #f4f7f5, raised paper #fbfcfa, deep ink #101828, muted ink #435164, cobalt #174ea6 and #103b80, faint/soft cobalt rules, sparse data lime #9fd818, one rare signal-red #c8313b proof mark. Maintain WCAG-conscious text contrast.
Materials/textures: Subtle recycled-paper raster grain, 1px cobalt press rules, faint horizontal notebook ruling, square clipped index tabs, restrained physical-paper register details. No gloss. Ordinary ledgers remain flat and unshadowed; if any depth appears, it must explain a real sheet overlap and remain very restrained.
Text constraints: Render all supplied headings, labels, lead copy, entry text, and action labels verbatim and legibly. Strong hierarchy at native desktop scale. Keep body lines comfortably readable. Avoid tiny or decorative illegible copy. Do not introduce any employer, job title, date, metric, client, company, testimonial, award, app name, project name, outcome, performance claim, or biographical detail beyond the supplied truth.
Avoid: homepage layout or homepage copy, GitHub contribution graphics, financial app dashboard, project cards, centered landing-page hero, poster composition, generic equal bento cards, rounded generic cards, pill controls, glossy surfaces, gradients, glassmorphism, drop-shadow card stacks, neon, crypto UI, fake terminal styling, decorative monospace overload, stock photos, people, portraits, invented icons, invented charts, dates, numerical metrics, watermarks, mockup perspective, browser chrome, dark full-page theme.
